text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The dirt GⅠ held at Oi Racecourse, the 
Japan Dirt Derby. At this midsummer night 
race, the excitement of the crowd reaches 
its absolute peak.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Under the watchful eye of her mentor, T.M. 
Opera O, will she be able to show the 
fruits of all her hard work?
